attributes.relationships: 沙利耶为摩德罗国王，成铠为诃利迪迦之子，慈悯为乔答摩之孙，马嘶为德罗纳之子，难敌为俱卢族国王，沙恭尼为妙力之子，优楼迦为吉多婆之子；俱卢族军队由沙利耶指挥，难敌居中军。

extraction_text: 般度族弓箭手分成三组迎击：猛光、束发、萨谛奇冲向沙利耶；坚战冲向沙利耶意图斩杀；阿周那冲向成铠和敢死队；怖军和苏摩迦族勇士冲向慈悯；玛德利的两个儿子（无种和偕天）攻向沙恭尼和优楼迦。

attributes.relationships: 猛光为木柱王之子，束发为毗湿摩之敌，萨谛奇为雅度族英雄，坚战为般度族长子，阿周那为般度族第三子，怖军为般度族第二子，无种和偕天为玛德利之子（般度族双胞胎）；般度族军队对抗俱卢族。

extraction_text: The combined sounds of battle - horse hooves, chariot wheels, war cries, elephant roars, musical instruments, and conch shells - create a thunderous noise like a storm.
The army formation resembled a forest in full bloom, with soldiers fighting bravely and bleeding profusely.
Many elephants fell under arrows and spears, collapsing like torn clouds.
The elephant army was scattered by brave warriors like clouds dispersed by wind.
Fallen war elephants appeared like mountains collapsing under thunderbolts at the end of an era.
Dead horses and riders piled up into hills on the battlefield.

A river to the other world formed on the battlefield with blood as water, chariots as whirlpools, banners as trees, bones as pebbles, arms as crocodiles, bows as currents, elephants as boulders, horses as stones, fat and marrow as mud, clubs as boats, canopies as swans, and flags as riverside trees.
This terrible river flowed with Kurus and Srinjayas mixed together, bringing joy to heroes and fear to cowards, flowing toward the world of ancestors.
True heroes crossed the river using their arms as iron poles and elephants, horses, and chariots as boats.
The cruel war continued with massive destruction of the fourfold army, resembling the battle between Devas and Asuras.
